author: TEDx Talks
description:
What if the problem with AI isn’t the technology but how we talk to it? Through humorous, relatable stories, from bad haircuts to awkward photos, Kunalsinh Kathia reveals a powerful insight: we often give incomplete instructions and expect perfect results. In the age of AI, that habit is holding us back.
This talk reframes prompting not as a technical skill, but as a fundamental human ability, one that now requires clarity, structure, and intention. Introducing a simple framework to communicate better with AI, he shows how better questions lead to better answers.

Because AI isn’t magic, it’s a mirror. And the future won’t belong to those who use AI. It will belong to those who know how to direct it.

description:
What if the most important thing you can do in pursuit of something meaningful is absolutely nothing at all?
In this quietly captivating TEDx talk, Aishwarya Sridhar makes a case for one of the most undervalued forces in any creative or professional life: patience. In a world that rewards speed, output, and constant momentum, the idea of sitting still and waiting has been stripped of its dignity. Aishwarya has spent countless hours motionless in forests, marshes, and grasslands waiting for a single unrepeatable moment. Through this, she knows something most people have forgotten. The best things do not come to those who move fastest, but to those who can be still the longest without giving up.

At TEDxEuless 2026, he'll reveal three lessons from the Mission: Impossible franchise that explain why most transformations fail—and how adopting the Ethan Hunt mindset can help you uncover the real mission behind any challenge you face. title: Everything You're Building Will Self-Destruct | Sidharth Ramsinghaney | TEDxEuless

At 13 years old, Tina moved from Jamaica to Canada carrying many questions immigrants can often relate to: Where do I belong? How do I stay true to who I am while trying to fit in? In this TEDx talk, she shares her journey of navigating identity, culture and connection while learning that belonging is something we create together. Through the idea of revolutionary love, she explores how supportive spaces can empower people to share their voice, story and identity without apology. description:
This talk reflects on how culture is not built by institutions or systems, but by the everyday choices of ordinary people. Through discipline, empathy, honesty, and love, he makes the case that strong character is the true foundation of meaningful success — for individuals and society alike.

 Amit Rai is an acclaimed Indian film director and writer known for his compelling storytelling and socially relevant cinema. He received the prestigious Gollapudi Srinivas Award in 2010 for his directorial debut Road to Sangam, a film that reflected his sensitivity towards complex human and societal narratives. As an associate director, he contributed to the critically acclaimed Marathi film Tingya, which garnered multiple national and international awards. After a significant hiatus, Amit Rai made a powerful comeback with OMG 2 (2023), the sequel to the widely loved Oh My God!. The film resonated strongly with audiences and critics alike, achieving both commercial success and meaningful impact.
title: Values First: The Human Blueprint for Lasting Success | Amit Rai | TEDxLucknow

description: In this talk, Nirbhay breaks the myth of fairness and explains how the world rewards outputs, not excuses. He highlights the idea of delusional self-belief, that is being so optimistic, hardworking and prepared that success becomes inevitable. He pushes the audience to take control of their lives, be responsible and create their own opportunities. Nirbhay Bahl, a young advocate practicing in commercial litigation, appearing regularly before the High Court, Supreme Court, NCLT, and NCLAT. Beyond the courtroom, he help professionals and entrepreneurs grow their personal brands on Instagram, having built his own account from scratch to over 150,000 followers in just five months. A half-marathon runner, he approach both law and personal growth with discipline, resilience and a focus on continuous improvement helping others push boundaries, achieve results and create impact. title: Power Rewrites: Unlearn Fairness. Evolve Strength. | Nirbhay Bahl | TEDxSVC

author: TEDx Talks
description: What happens when a power plant is required to benefit the community in which it is built? South Africa's Renewable Energy Independent Power Producer Programme is a policy that requires any power plant built to return direct benefits to the surrounding community for 20 years. That one requirement unlocked $14 billion in investment, trained unemployed youth as solar technicians and battery specialists, and built self-sustaining local economies across the continent. Africa holds 60% of the world's best solar resources, yet it receives less than 2% of global renewable energy investment. This blueprint for community-benefit-integrated energy investment is the missing business model that truly empowers people and places.  Boipelo Moloabi is a South African entrepreneur and energy access advocate who has built a career around proving that renewable energy deployment in Sub-Saharan Africa can deliver both community transformation and sustainable profit. title: One policy that turned energy poverty into a $14 billion economy | Boipelo Moloabi | TEDxBoston
